articles.title: BJP files police complaint against Kharge over 'baap' remark targeting PM Modi
articles.description: Bharatiya Janata Party has lodged a police complaint against Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge in Patna. The complaint relates to Kharge's remarks about Prime Minister Modi during an event during 139th birth anniversary Bihar's first CM, Shrikrishna Singh. Krishna Kumar Singh, a BJP worker, demands an apology from Kharge within 24 hours. The initial report was filed at Kotwali police station, then transferred to Gandhi Maidan.

articles.title: ABBA’s Chiquitita raised over $5 million for UNICEF in 45 years; how the 1979 hit continues to protect children
articles.description: ABBA's song Chiquitita has raised over US$5 million for UNICEF since its release in 1979. This funding supports various programs aimed at protecting vulnerable children from abuse and violence. The pledge originated during a concert at the United Nations to promote children's rights. In 2021, ABBA extended its support by pledging royalties from another song to UNICEF.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia’s Singapore plan: How Riyadh aims to protect Asian oil supplies from 2027
articles.description: Saudi Arabia is set to store crude oil in Singapore starting in the second half of 2027. This arrangement aims to enhance energy security in the region amid supply disruptions. Singapore's Jurong Rock Caverns will provide storage facilities for Saudi crude oil supplies. The agreement will allow Saudi Aramco to bring supplies closer to key Asian markets.

articles.title: Stock market today: Sensex jumps over 200 points, Nifty50 trades flat
articles.full_text: Rupee ended the previous week at 94.94 against the US dollar, after strengthening to a six-week high of 94.30. The currency had gained ground following a series of measures announced by the Reserve Bank of India to support it. However, the recovery faced pressure towards the end of the week as rising oil prices and broader risk aversion weighed on sentiment. The rupee's movement remained closely linked to developments in the oil market, with Brent crude trading well above $110 a barrel. Concerns over India's external finances also persisted, keeping attention on the RBI's efforts to contain the currency's losses.

articles.title: Bank holiday on Valmiki Jayanti: Will banks remain shut on October 26? Check list
articles.description: As October unfolds, India's vibrant festival season translates into various state-specific bank holidays. On October 26, banking services will pause in Tripura, Chandigarh, Jammu and Kashmir, and Himachal Pradesh. Important dates approaching include Karva Chauth on October 29 and Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's birth anniversary on October 31. Although digital transactions persist, customers are encouraged to verify local holiday observances to sidestep any unexpected closures at physical branches.

articles.title: Delhi govt schools to get medical rooms with first-aid facilities, dedicated health worker
articles.description: The Delhi government is planning to set up first-aid medical facilities in all government schools across the city. This initiative will ensure that trained health workers provide immediate care for students during school hours. Each school will have access to basic medical assistance for minor injuries and sudden illnesses. The facilities will also address menstrual health needs for girl students in a private space.
